messages:
Jordan: Dropping the latest invite drawer mock — looking for a quick decision on SSO control (status pill vs toggle), a small "preview as role" affordance, and how "View changes" should go to Audit Logs. Figma: https://figma.com/file/invite-preview-v5 Priya: Strong +1 for a status pill instead of a toggle. We shouldn't surface org-wide controls in an invite flow. Pill can read "SSO enforced (org)" or "SSO not enforced" and have an info action. Liam: Agree. Also like the idea of a "Preview as role" microflow: a small eye icon next to each role that opens a mini modal showing permissions. Helps PMs validate before sending. Marta: Accessibility points: pill must be tabbable and announce its state. Preview modal must be keyboard-trappable and have a clear heading. Also confirm color contrast for pill and the inline helper text. Noah: Backend note: deep-link to Audit Logs is straightforward. We'll accept params: actorId, action=invite, objectType=member, startTime, endTime, and returnTo=drawer. We can also expose an API to fetch the last 5 related audit events for a compact inline view in the confirmation drawer. Jordan: Nice — so proposal: show inline micro-summary (last 3 changes) in the confirmation panel and include a "View full audit" link that deep-links to Audit Logs with filters. That avoids forcing users away unless they want full context. Priya: Copy ask: change toast from "Invites sent" to "Invites queued — well email recipients shortly." Also add persistent "Open invite status" link in the drawer header for keyboard users. Liam: For keyboard UX: tab order should be email -> role multiselect -> preview actions -> SSO pill -> Send button. Preview eye icons must be reachable via Enter/Space and close with Escape returning focus to the icon. Marta: ARIA example for the pill and info modal suggestion: ```

SSO enforced for this organization

SSO enforcement is managed in Organization settings. Changes affect everyone.

``` Make sure the hidden dialog becomes visible and aria-expanded toggles accordingly. UXBot: Accessibility scan: current pill color fails AA at 14px. Recommend darker token #1f2b38 for text and #e6f0ff for background variant. Also flag: preview modal heading must be programmatically focusable. DeployBot: Visual regression: invite-preview-v5 failed for pill contrast and focus-ring thickness. CI snapshot: https://ci.internal/snapshots/2135008765/diff.png Jordan: Action items: (1) Priya update Figma: pill + preview eye microflow + copy changes (2) Liam add keyboard flow notes + preview modal behavior + PR examples (3) Marta produce a short a11y checklist for drawer + toast live region (4) Noah add audit micro-summary API and deep-link params (5) UXBot will re-run scan after updates. I'll book a 20m follow-up tomorrow 9am PT to sign off. Priya: Will update frames today and ping. Liam: Adding aria/keyboard snippets to PR now. Marta: I'll draft the checklist and include contrast tokens. Noah: Drafting API endpoints and sample deep-link URLs, will post in the design doc. Jordan: Thanks team — closing for now, reopen if anything blocks the PR. :thumbsup:
